story_theme_en: A fruit shop has oranges filling 3/4 of a box and mangosteens filling 1/2 of a box. If all the fruits are combined, how many parts of the box do they fill? Do the oranges and mangosteens together exceed 1 full box?
helper_tip: Make denominators equal before adding by finding the LCM of the denominators
hint_th: ต้องทำส่วนให้เท่ากันก่อนบวก โดยใช้ ค.ร.น. ของส่วน
think_story_en: Make the denominators equal: 3/4 = 6/8 and 1/2 = 4/8. Total = 6/8 + 4/8 = 10/8 = 1 2/8 boxes. This exceeds 1 full box because 10/8 > 8/8. They exceed by 2/8 of a box.
